Một hôm hai người cãi nhau máu lửa qua điện thoại. Peter tắt máy, tức giận. Cảm thấy mình có lỗi, bạn sáng tác thư tình bằng tiếng Việt (để tăng độ tình cảm), gọi điện lại anh ấy, đọc cho anh ấy nghe.

The names Phước and Phức are also kind of f-, friggin' complicated. Let's say you're a Saigon girl dating a Vietnamese man in America. His real name is Phước, but all his friends call him Peter. One day you have an awful fight with him on the phone. Peter hangs up, pissed off. I'd like to tell you this, I had held Confucianist-Mencianist morality in high regard ever since I learned a thing or two about it. Surely, Confucianism-Mencianism is good, but where are we going to look for it now? Bring it back from China? Search for it in Vietnamese records? I don't think we could find it even if we lit up some torches, because Vietnam as well as China have long abandoned it.

Confucianism-Mencianism is not the monarchs' authoritarianism you guys think it is, no.
